correctness.rationale: Over RCA_0, on classes of known exact size k, compute their complete k-element successor lists by a search terminating by hypothesis; recursive formula evaluation is computable relative to the given frame and atoms, and its graph exists by Delta_1 comprehension. On classes of size at most two, ACA_0 forms the arithmetical set D of worlds possessing a distinct partner; with D the analogous evaluator is computable. Conversely an injection f determines a reflexive symmetric transitive relation by pairing even 2n with odd 2s+1 exactly when f(s)=n. Injectivity makes classes singletons or pairs. Under an explicit parity assignment, V(2n, box p_0)=0 iff n belongs to range(f); existence of the full valuation therefore forms every injection range and yields ACA_0. All assumptions and quantifiers are stated, including that known class size need not be supplied as an enumeration. Finite verifier separately checks the simplified valuation equation on 119 frames, 5898 valuations, 375078 formula/world comparisons and 30 finite range cases. Finite tests do not prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The primary closest paper (Takeda 2026, Theorem 2.27) proves VEL for all image-finite frames equivalent to ACA_0. This implies the upper direction here, and its directed injective graph already demonstrates a one-successor lower-bound technique, neither of which is novel. Its construction is not reflexive, symmetric or transitive and does not yield a reversal for 1-or-2-element S5 equivalence classes without an additional transformation. July 2026 Proposition 2.4 uses a universal rather than two-element S5 relation. Friedman 2017 already uses a matching equivalence encoding for a different maximal-emulation principle. The new statement identifies the VEL reversal inside two-point S5 cells and the unexpected distinction between known exact cell sizes and merely bounded cell sizes. Specific older equivalence formulations remain a risk.
residual_risks: An earlier theorem phrased as computability of modal evaluation on finite equivalence classes might imply the stated positive and negative parts.
The matching encoding of an injection range is classical and should not be presented as a new stand-alone technique.
No independent specialist has reviewed formal details of the RCA_0 oracle-recursion proof.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper leaves open a natural structural refinement: how little Kripke accessibility suffices for the comprehension strength of modal valuation extension. The exact threshold within equivalence-class S5 frames shows that knowing each finite cell size permits RCA_0 while only knowing a sharp upper bound of two forces ACA_0. The depth-one parity instance isolates precisely the information-theoretic obstacle (detecting the second member), and it is a new complete natural classification by cell-size information, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine finite recomputation. The result remains useful in formal semantics and reverse mathematics independently of the finite sanity checker.
